# Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Compatibility.CommunityToolkit

Adapts CommunityToolkit.Mvvm IMessenger to MVVMExpress IMessageHub.

NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress.Compatibility.CommunityToolkit
GitHub: https://github.com/nuvyntralabs/Plugin.Maui.MVVMExpress
License: MIT
Version: 0.6.1-preview (`--prerelease`)

## Do not use when

The app does not already reference CommunityToolkit.Mvvm. Do not add this only to get a messenger.
